title: Run specialists in parallel
instruction: Launch specialist children concurrently; each allocates its own artifact IDs.
expectedOutcome: Every child receives distinct IDs and no artifact is overwritten.
notes: ⚠️ RETIRED 2026-08-22, approval REVOKED first. `Launch specialist children concurrently` is not an actionable instruction: no orchestration path exists, it names no concrete command and no remediation, and real concurrent orchestration would REOPEN #79's reasoning-freshness trigger. It was useful as the evidence-slice fixture that proved RBS -> assertion -> evidence end to end (5c), and it is kept as history rather than deleted — but it must not ship as something a recipient acts on. ⚠️ It stays the worked example in ACC-0012 and in stage 6's vacuity finding, where it is cited as a PAST case rather than a live one.
